Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
rai...@mich.com wrote:
> The Gas Powered Chainsaw shows a cost of 1 pool. The card text
> published by the WOTC list the GPCS at a cost of one blood.
> Which is the correct cost, blood or pool?

Card text.

The lists published by WotC are always secondary to the actual card
text, since no attempt was made to incorporate errata into the
card lists (the lists are attempts to get the actual, physical card
text down in an electronic format - some errors have crept into
this list, and are all differences between the list and actual card
text are unintentional).
